description: This PHP source file defines a function 'file_download' that handles server-side file downloads with support for range requests, intended to allow clients to download troubleshooting log files from the server. It manages HTTP headers to support partial content delivery and sets up the download filename based on POST parameters.

methods.name: file_download
methods.description: Handles HTTP headers and streams a specified file to the client for download, supporting range requests for resumable downloads.
